record.dic_text:
02365 Chuwshay {khoo-shah'-ee}

源自 02363; 陽性專有名詞

AV - Hushai 14; 14

戶篩 = "匆忙"
1) 一名亞基人, 大衛王的朋友 
2) 所羅門王手下的官員巴拿的父親 (#王上 4:16|)
record.edic_text:
02365 Chuwshay {khoo-shah'-ee}

from 02363;; n pr m

AV - Hushai 14; 14

Hushai = "hasting"
1) an Archite, a friend of David
2) the father of Baana, an officer of Solomon; probably the same as 1
